# Bosses and prison guards

[Encounter stats by sea](../../world/encounter-stats.md)

## Challenge bosses

Armament and Observation have a floor based on the encounter’s stage as a share of the **50,000 Doriki** cap, up to **500** in each. Boss health is multiplied by the figures below. Outgoing damage scales with the encounter’s stage and the boss’s original difficulty, so it varies by fight.

Hard rematches use their own stage. Use the normal and Hard columns for their respective fights.

| Challenge | Normal stage | Normal HP factor | Hard stage | Hard HP factor |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Higuma | 1,000 | 2× | 50,000 | 3.875× |
| Morgan | 1,500 | 2× | 50,000 | 3.875× |
| Alvida | 1,500 | 2× | 50,000 | 3.875× |

## Impel Down guards and wardens

The table shows health after Doriki scaling and the standard jailer’s hit before target defenses. Hooded guards start with **30% more Doriki** than a uniformed jailer on the same floor. Haki is the roll range for the floor. The last column shows which guards can use Armament techniques.

| Floor | Jailer Doriki | Uniformed HP | Standard hit (HP) | Armor | Haki | Armament users (uniform / hood) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 2,000–5,000 | 50–125 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 0% / 0% |
| 1 | 5,000–10,500 | 125–253.125 | 4 | 0 | 25–60 | 0% / 5% |
| 2 | 9,000–16,000 | 225–287.5 | 7 | 1 | 60–125 | 5% / 10% |
| 3 | 13,500–21,500 | 271.875–321.875 | 9 | 2 | 125–200 | 15% / 25% |
| 4 | 19,000–27,000 | 306.25–356.25 | 12 | 3 | 200–275 | 25% / 35% |
| 5 | 25,000–32,500 | 343.75–390.625 | 16 | 4 | 275–350 | 40% / 50% |
| 6 | 30,000–36,500 | 375–415.625 | 20 | 5 | 350–425 | 50% / 60% |

Head jailers take the top Doriki roll from their floor. Their HP is **3.5×** the floor’s top jailer HP. The Chief of the Guard and the Warden use **3×** and **8×** of the health calculated for their respective Doriki rows.

| 1 | Boss tier | 25,000 | — | 7 | 8 | 150 |

| 3 | Boss tier | 60,000 | — | 14 | 16 | 375 |
| 4 | Boss tier | 90,000 | — | 16 | 18 | 450 |
